title: What Are Google Merchant Center Conversational Attributes?
summary: Google Merchant Center conversational attributes are optional fields that help AI systems understand your products. Learn what they are and how to add them.
body_markdown:
Google Merchant Center conversational attributes are six optional product fields that add to the main Merchant Center product data specification. Google says they help AI systems and conversational agents, including AI Mode in Search, understand product details better. Google also says they can support traditional search.


They don't replace required Shopping attributes such as title, description, GTIN or availability. They also aren't the same as rewriting your description in a more conversational tone. Each field has an official name and format, and Google treats every one of them as optional for each product.


This guide covers the six fields and how to submit them, along with the catalog data that needs to be accurate before you fill them. It explains the fields one by one. It doesn't cover checkout protocols or required attributes by channel.


## What are Google Merchant Center conversational attributes?


They are a defined set of optional attributes in the Google Merchant Center product data specification. As of 12 Nov 2026,[Google's conversational attributes help page](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17085370?hl=en) lists six:


- Question and answer` \[question_and_answer\]`
- Document link` \[document_link\]`
- Related product` \[related_product\]`
- Item group title` \[item_group_title\]`
- Variant option` \[variant_option\]`
- Popularity rank` \[popularity_rank\]`


Google describes them as completely optional and designed to add to your primary product data. Google says they can help customers find information about your products on AI-driven surfaces such as AI Mode in Search, and can also improve traditional search. Including them doesn't change the approval status of products you already submit.


If you already provide the same facts in description` \[description\]` , product highlight` \[product_highlight\]` or product detail` \[product_detail\]` , Google says you don't need to repeat that data in the conversational attributes.


## How do you add conversational attributes in Merchant Center?


You add them to your existing product data setup. You don't need to build a new feed.


### Choose a submission method


Google recommends a supplemental data source. You can also add the fields to your primary data source or submit them through the Merchant API.


A supplemental source works well when your feed is already approved. You can add the new fields on top of it without rewriting the required attributes.


### Steps to add the fields through a supplemental data source


1. **Collect the source data for each field you plan to use.** Only fill a field when you have accurate, product-specific values for it.
2. **Check for overlap with data you already send.** Leave out facts already in description, product highlight or product detail. Skip` question_and_answer` when the same answers are in PDFs you send through` document_link` .
3. **Format the file using Google's TSV template example.** The template is on the conversational attributes help page. Use the official attribute names exactly as Google writes them.
4. **Create the supplemental data source.** Follow the official instructions in[Google's data source help](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/14990942#supplementaldatasource) .


### Source data you need first


The new fields are only as reliable as the data behind them. Before you submit, you need:


- Real shopper questions and answers
- PDFs you have permission to host
- Variant groupings
- Related-product identifiers
- A popularity figure you can stand behind


### How Hypotenuse AI prepares that data


[Hypotenuse's AI product data enrichment](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/features/ecommerce-product-data-enrichment) fills missing attributes from the web, vendor PDPs, data sheets, product images or PDFs. It shows where each value came from, and your team reviews the values before you publish or sync to the PIM or platform you already use. Map that reviewed catalog into Merchant Center. Don't invent answers when you build the feed.


For catalogs with a lot of PDFs,[AI product attribute mapping](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/features/ai-attribute-mapping) extracts structured values from documents and maps them to the fields you choose. You can then download or sync those values.


## What are the six Google Merchant Center conversational attributes?


Each field below uses Google's official name, technical name and rules, taken from the detailed specification page for that attribute. Google states that each of these attributes can be used in all countries. Don't invent extra field names, and don't present unofficial limits as Google's.


### Question and answer` \[question_and_answer\]`


This field holds FAQs about the product.[Google's question_and_answer specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17085211?hl=en) sets these rules:


- A group attribute with two required sub-attributes: question` \[question\]` and answer` \[answer\]`
- Each sub-attribute can be up to 1,000 characters
- Each product can have up to 30 question-and-answer pairs
- The total for one product is capped at 10,000 characters


Use it for user, merchant or manufacturer questions about the product itself. Don't include prices, dates or keyword lists.


Don't submit this field if you already send` document_link` and the same information is in those PDFs. In that case, Google pulls the FAQ information from the documents instead.


### Document link` \[document_link\]`


This field points to authoritative product PDFs, such as training manuals, user guides, assembly instructions or package inserts. The document must be about the product, not a company overview.[Google's document_link specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17084656?hl=en) requires:


- A URL starting with http:// or https://
- The .PDF format
- A URL of no more than 2,000 characters
- No more than five links per product
- No more than 50 MB per file


### Related product` \[related_product\]`


This field lists other items in your inventory that connect to the product.[Google's related_product specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17085213?hl=en) requires three sub-attributes: relationship type` \[relationship_type\]` , identifier type` \[identifier_type\]` and identifier` \[identifier\]` .


The supported relationship types are:


- Part of set` \[part_of_set\]`
- Required part` \[required_part\]`
- Often bought with` \[often_bought_with\]`
- Substitute` \[substitute\]`
- Different brand` \[different_brand\]`
- Accessory` \[accessory\]`


Identifier type is either GTIN` \[gtin\]` or ID` \[id\]` . You can repeat the group up to 30 times. Use a separate value for each related product. The identifier can only contain letters, numbers, underscores or dashes.


### Item group title` \[item_group_title\]`


This field gives one shared title to a product that has multiple variants.[Google's item_group_title specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17085146?hl=en) sets these rules:


- Use it with item group ID` \[item_group_id\]`
- It is a single string of 1 to 150 characters
- Every variant in the same group must use the same title
- The group title should differ from each variant's own title` \[title\]`


### Variant option` \[variant_option\]`


This field names the properties that set one variant apart from another, such as size and color, or memory and display size. Use it with` item_group_title` and` item_group_id` when you sell the product in different variants. Don't submit it for a product that isn't a variant.


[Google's variant_option specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17085214?hl=en) sets these rules:


- Two sub-attributes, name` \[name\]` and value` \[value\]` , each up to 250 characters
- The group can repeat up to 30 times
- Variants in the same group must share the same set of name values
- Each variant needs a unique combination of values


### Popularity rank` \[popularity_rank\]`


This field gives the product's popularity as a percentage of your total inventory. A higher value means the product sells better than other items you sell.[Google's popularity_rank specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17085297?hl=en) requires a number between 0.0 and 100.0, with no more than one decimal place and no percent sign.


To set the value:


1. Base it on recent sales so it stays accurate against your own inventory.
2. Calculate it against products in the same general category, as Google suggests.
3. Update it when the product's popularity changes substantially.


### Complete the rest of the listing first


[SEO and GEO optimization for ecommerce](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/features/seo-geo) enriches the attributes that search engines and AI answer engines rely on and improves feed quality. It doesn't replace Merchant Center's own submission tools.


## Frequently asked questions


### Are conversational attributes required in Merchant Center?


No. Google describes them as completely optional, and each of the six attribute pages says the field is optional for each product. They add to the primary product data specification. They are also separate from the[required product attributes by channel](https://www.hypotenuse.ai/blog/product-attributes-by-channel) that Google Shopping and other marketplaces already expect.


### Does submitting conversational attributes affect product approval?


No. Google states that including conversational attributes won't affect the approval status of your existing products.


### Should you copy description or product highlight data into conversational attributes?


No. If you already submit the same details in description, product highlight or product detail, Google says you don't need to repeat that data in the conversational attributes. For` question_and_answer` , skip the field when the same answers are already in PDFs sent through` document_link` .


### Can conversational attributes be used in every country?


Yes. Each of the six official attribute pages says the attribute can be used in all countries. Other Merchant Center AI features can have different availability, so check the help page for the specific feature.


### Do conversational attributes guarantee that products appear in AI Mode?


No. Google doesn't say that submitting these fields will rank a product higher or include it in AI Mode.


Google does say the fields can help customers find information about your products on AI-driven surfaces such as AI Mode in Search, and can also improve traditional search.


## Start with accurate catalog data


Conversational attributes are useful when your catalog already has accurate answers, documents, variant structure and product relationships to put in them. Fix that source data first. Then submit the official fields through a supplemental source, your primary source or the Merchant API.
